proposals.rule: From 20 June 2023, we removed the 1|2|3 Current Account and Select Current Account from our product range.
proposals.exception: From 11 May 2026, we’re increasing the monthly fee on our 1|2|3, Select and Private current accounts from £4 to £5.
proposals.why: The exception applies to existing 1|2|3 and Select accounts that are still held, while the rule applies to new customers who can no longer open those accounts.

proposals.rule: If you cancel Extra you’ll lose access to its benefits, but we’ll keep your Monzo Current Account open.
proposals.exception: If you cancel Extra you can continue using your benefits until your next payment date, but you won’t get a refund.
proposals.why: covers cancellations after the 14‑day cooling‑off period
